<RuleLanguageLinks current="css" languages={[{"id":"css","label":"CSS","href":"/linter/rules/no-excessive-selector-complexity/css/"}]} />

:::caution
This rule is part of the [nursery](/linter/#nursery) group. This means that it is experimental and the behavior can change at any time.
:::
## Summary
- Rule available since: `v2.6.7`
- Diagnostic Category: [`lint/nursery/noExcessiveSelectorComplexity`](/reference/diagnostics#diagnostic-category)
- This rule doesn't have a fix.
- The default severity of this rule is [**warning**](/reference/diagnostics#warning).
- Sources: 
  - Same as [`css/selector-complexity`](https://github.com/eslint/css/blob/main/docs/rules/selector-complexity.md)

## How to configure
```json title="biome.json"
{
	"linter": {
		"rules": {
			"nursery": {
				"noExcessiveSelectorComplexity": "error"
			}
		}
	}
}

```
## Description
Limit how complex selectors can be, and disallow chosen parts of selectors.

Long selectors that mix many IDs, element names, attributes, and pseudo-classes are hard
to read and hard to override. They also tie styles closely to the structure of the page,
so small changes to the HTML can break them.

This rule lets you set a maximum for each kind of selector part, and list combinators,
pseudo-classes, pseudo-elements, attributes, and attribute operators that aren't
allowed. The rule does nothing until at least one option is set.

Each selector in a comma-separated list is checked on its own. For example, `#a, #b`
contains two selectors with one ID each.

Selectors inside a pseudo-class such as `:not()`, `:is()`, or `:has()` are checked as
separate selectors, and don't count toward the selector that contains them. For example,
`#a:not(#b)` contains two selectors with one ID each.

Nested selectors are checked as written, without combining them with the selectors of
their parent rules.

## Examples

### Invalid

```json title='biome.json'
{
	"linter": {
		"rules": {
			"nursery": {
				"noExcessiveSelectorComplexity": {
					"level": "on",
					"options": {
						"maxIds": 1,
						"disallowPseudoClasses": [
							"hover"
						]
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

```

```css
#main #sidebar {}
```

```css

#footer {}
```

## Options

### `maxIds`

Default: no limit

The maximum number of ID selectors, such as `#main`, allowed in a single selector.

```json title='biome.json'
{
	"linter": {
		"rules": {
			"nursery": {
				"noExcessiveSelectorComplexity": {
					"level": "on",
					"options": {
						"maxIds": 1
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

```

#### Invalid

```css
#main > #sidebar {}
```

### `maxTypes`

Default: no limit

The maximum number of type selectors allowed in a single selector. A type selector
matches elements by their tag name, such as `div` or `a`.

```json title='biome.json'
{
	"linter": {
		"rules": {
			"nursery": {
				"noExcessiveSelectorComplexity": {
					"level": "on",
					"options": {
						"maxTypes": 2
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

```

#### Invalid

```css
ul li a {}
```

### `maxAttributes`

Default: no limit

The maximum number of attribute selectors, such as `[type="text"]`, allowed in a single
selector.

```json title='biome.json'
{
	"linter": {
		"rules": {
			"nursery": {
				"noExcessiveSelectorComplexity": {
					"level": "on",
					"options": {
						"maxAttributes": 1
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

```

#### Invalid

```css
[name="email"][type="text"] {}
```

### `maxPseudoClasses`

Default: no limit

The maximum number of pseudo-classes, such as `:hover` or `:first-child`, allowed in a
single selector. Pseudo-elements such as `::before` don't count, including the older
single-colon forms `:before`, `:after`, `:first-line`, and `:first-letter`.

```json title='biome.json'
{
	"linter": {
		"rules": {
			"nursery": {
				"noExcessiveSelectorComplexity": {
					"level": "on",
					"options": {
						"maxPseudoClasses": 1
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

```

#### Invalid

```css
li:first-child:hover {}
```

### `maxUniversals`

Default: no limit

The maximum number of universal selectors (`*`) allowed in a single selector.

```json title='biome.json'
{
	"linter": {
		"rules": {
			"nursery": {
				"noExcessiveSelectorComplexity": {
					"level": "on",
					"options": {
						"maxUniversals": 1
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

```

#### Invalid

```css
* > * {}
```

### `maxCompounds`

Default: no limit

The maximum number of compound selectors allowed in a single selector. A compound
selector is a group of selectors written together without spaces or combinators. For
example, `nav a.link:hover` has two compound selectors: `nav` and `a.link:hover`.

```json title='biome.json'
{
	"linter": {
		"rules": {
			"nursery": {
				"noExcessiveSelectorComplexity": {
					"level": "on",
					"options": {
						"maxCompounds": 2
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

```

#### Invalid

```css
nav ul a {}
```

Visit </span><span style=\"color: lightgreen;\"><a href=\"https://biomejs.dev/linter/#nursery\">https://biomejs.dev/linter/#nursery</a></span><span style=\"color: lightgreen;\"> for more information.</span><br />  <br /></code></pre>"} />

#### Valid

```css
nav a.link:hover {}
```

### `maxCombinators`

Default: no limit

The maximum number of combinators allowed in a single selector. A combinator is the
symbol between two compound selectors: a space, `>`, `+`, `~`, or `||`.

```json title='biome.json'
{
	"linter": {
		"rules": {
			"nursery": {
				"noExcessiveSelectorComplexity": {
					"level": "on",
					"options": {
						"maxCombinators": 1
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

```

#### Invalid

```css
.menu > .item > a {}
```

<Fragment set:html={"<pre class=\"language-text\"><code class=\"language-text\">code-block.css:1:1 <a href=\"https://biomejs.dev/linter/rules/no-excessive-selector-complexity\">lint/nursery/noExcessiveSelectorComplexity</a> ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━<br /><br />  <strong><span style=\"color: Orange;\">⚠</span></strong> <span style=\"color: Orange;\">This selector has too many combinators: it has 2, but the limit is 1.</span><br />  <br />  <strong><span style=\"color: Tomato;\">&gt;</span></strong> <strong>1 │ </strong>.menu &gt; .item &gt; a &#123;&#125;<br />   <strong>   │ </strong><strong><span style=\"color: Tomato;\">^</span></strong><strong><span style=\"color: Tomato;\">^</span></strong><strong><span style=\"color: Tomato;\">^</span></strong><strong><span style=\"color: Tomato;\">^</span></strong><strong><span style=\"color: Tomato;\">^</span></strong><strong><span style=\"color: Tomato;\">^</span></strong><strong><span style=\"color: Tomato;\">^</span></strong><strong><span style=\"color: Tomato;\">^</span></strong><strong><span style=\"color: Tomato;\">^</span></strong><strong><span style=\"color: Tomato;\">^</span></strong><strong><span style=\"color: Tomato;\">^</span></strong><strong><span style=\"color: Tomato;\">^</span></strong><strong><span style=\"color: Tomato;\">^</span></strong><strong><span style=\"color: Tomato;\">^</span></strong><strong><span style=\"color: Tomato;\">^</span></strong><strong><span style=\"color: Tomato;\">^</span></strong><strong><span style=\"color: Tomato;\">^</span></strong><br />    <strong>2 │ </strong><br />  <br />  <strong><span style=\"color: lightgreen;\">ℹ</span></strong> <span style=\"color: lightgreen;\">Complex selectors are hard to read and override, and break easily when the page structure changes.</span><br />  <br />  <strong><span style=\"color: lightgreen;\">ℹ</span></strong> <span style=\"color: lightgreen;\">Simplify the selector, for example by giving the element a class and selecting it directly.</span><br />  <br />  <strong><span style=\"color: lightgreen;\">ℹ</span></strong> <span style=\"color: lightgreen;\">This rule belongs to the nursery group, which means it is not yet stable and may change in the future. Visit </span><span style=\"color: lightgreen;\"><a href=\"https://biomejs.dev/linter/#nursery\">https://biomejs.dev/linter/#nursery</a></span><span style=\"color: lightgreen;\"> for more information.</span><br />  <br /></code></pre>"} />

#### Valid

```css
.menu > .item {}
```

### `disallowCombinators`

Default: `[]`

Combinators that aren't allowed. Accepted values are `" "` (a space, which selects
elements inside another element), `">"`, `"+"`, `"~"`, and `"||"`.

```json title='biome.json'
{
	"linter": {
		"rules": {
			"nursery": {
				"noExcessiveSelectorComplexity": {
					"level": "on",
					"options": {
						"disallowCombinators": [
							">"
						]
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

```

#### Invalid

```css
.menu > .item {}
```

<Fragment set:html={"<pre class=\"language-text\"><code class=\"language-text\">code-block.css:1:7 <a href=\"https://biomejs.dev/linter/rules/no-excessive-selector-complexity\">lint/nursery/noExcessiveSelectorComplexity</a> ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━<br /><br />  <strong><span style=\"color: Orange;\">⚠</span></strong> <span style=\"color: Orange;\">The combinator </span><span style=\"color: Orange;\"><strong>&gt;</strong></span><span style=\"color: Orange;\"> isn't allowed.</span><br />  <br />  <strong><span style=\"color: Tomato;\">&gt;</span></strong> <strong>1 │ </strong>.menu &gt; .item &#123;&#125;<br />   <strong>   │ </strong>      <strong><span style=\"color: Tomato;\">^</span></strong><br />    <strong>2 │ </strong><br />  <br />  <strong><span style=\"color: lightgreen;\">ℹ</span></strong> <span style=\"color: lightgreen;\">The rule's configuration disallows this combinator in selectors.</span><br />  <br />  <strong><span style=\"color: lightgreen;\">ℹ</span></strong> <span style=\"color: lightgreen;\">Rewrite the selector without it, for example by giving the element a class and selecting it directly.</span><br />  <br />  <strong><span style=\"color: lightgreen;\">ℹ</span></strong> <span style=\"color: lightgreen;\">This rule belongs to the nursery group, which means it is not yet stable and may change in the future. Visit </span><span style=\"color: lightgreen;\"><a href=\"https://biomejs.dev/linter/#nursery\">https://biomejs.dev/linter/#nursery</a></span><span style=\"color: lightgreen;\"> for more information.</span><br />  <br /></code></pre>"} />

#### Valid

```css
.menu .item {}
```

### `disallowPseudoClasses`

Default: `[]`

Pseudo-classes that aren't allowed, written without the leading colon. Names are compared
without regard to letter case.

```json title='biome.json'
{
	"linter": {
		"rules": {
			"nursery": {
				"noExcessiveSelectorComplexity": {
					"level": "on",
					"options": {
						"disallowPseudoClasses": [
							"hover"
						]
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

```

#### Invalid

```css
a:not(.active):hover {}
```

<Fragment set:html={"<pre class=\"language-text\"><code class=\"language-text\">code-block.css:1:15 <a href=\"https://biomejs.dev/linter/rules/no-excessive-selector-complexity\">lint/nursery/noExcessiveSelectorComplexity</a> ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━<br /><br />  <strong><span style=\"color: Orange;\">⚠</span></strong> <span style=\"color: Orange;\">The pseudo-class </span><span style=\"color: Orange;\"><strong>:hover</strong></span><span style=\"color: Orange;\"> isn't allowed.</span><br />  <br />  <strong><span style=\"color: Tomato;\">&gt;</span></strong> <strong>1 │ </strong>a:not(.active):hover &#123;&#125;<br />   <strong>   │ </strong>              <strong><span style=\"color: Tomato;\">^</span></strong><strong><span style=\"color: Tomato;\">^</span></strong><strong><span style=\"color: Tomato;\">^</span></strong><strong><span style=\"color: Tomato;\">^</span></strong><strong><span style=\"color: Tomato;\">^</span></strong><strong><span style=\"color: Tomato;\">^</span></strong><br />    <strong>2 │ </strong><br />  <br />  <strong><span style=\"color: lightgreen;\">ℹ</span></strong> <span style=\"color: lightgreen;\">The rule's configuration disallows this pseudo-class in selectors.</span><br />  <br />  <strong><span style=\"color: lightgreen;\">ℹ</span></strong> <span style=\"color: lightgreen;\">Rewrite the selector without it, for example by giving the element a class and selecting it directly.</span><br />  <br />  <strong><span style=\"color: lightgreen;\">ℹ</span></strong> <span style=\"color: lightgreen;\">This rule belongs to the nursery group, which means it is not yet stable and may change in the future. Visit </span><span style=\"color: lightgreen;\"><a href=\"https://biomejs.dev/linter/#nursery\">https://biomejs.dev/linter/#nursery</a></span><span style=\"color: lightgreen;\"> for more information.</span><br />  <br /></code></pre>"} />

#### Valid

```css
a:not(.active) {}
```

### `disallowPseudoElements`

Default: `[]`

Pseudo-elements that aren't allowed, written without the leading colons. Names are
compared without regard to letter case. The older single-colon forms `:before`,
`:after`, `:first-line`, and `:first-letter` are checked as well.

```json title='biome.json'
{
	"linter": {
		"rules": {
			"nursery": {
				"noExcessiveSelectorComplexity": {
					"level": "on",
					"options": {
						"disallowPseudoElements": [
							"before"
						]
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

```

#### Invalid

```css
a:before {}
```

<Fragment set:html={"<pre class=\"language-text\"><code class=\"language-text\">code-block.css:1:2 <a href=\"https://biomejs.dev/linter/rules/no-excessive-selector-complexity\">lint/nursery/noExcessiveSelectorComplexity</a> ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━<br /><br />  <strong><span style=\"color: Orange;\">⚠</span></strong> <span style=\"color: Orange;\">The pseudo-element </span><span style=\"color: Orange;\"><strong>:before</strong></span><span style=\"color: Orange;\"> isn't allowed.</span><br />  <br />  <strong><span style=\"color: Tomato;\">&gt;</span></strong> <strong>1 │ </strong>a:before &#123;&#125;<br />   <strong>   │ </strong> <strong><span style=\"color: Tomato;\">^</span></strong><strong><span style=\"color: Tomato;\">^</span></strong><strong><span style=\"color: Tomato;\">^</span></strong><strong><span style=\"color: Tomato;\">^</span></strong><strong><span style=\"color: Tomato;\">^</span></strong><strong><span style=\"color: Tomato;\">^</span></strong><strong><span style=\"color: Tomato;\">^</span></strong><br />    <strong>2 │ </strong><br />  <br />  <strong><span style=\"color: lightgreen;\">ℹ</span></strong> <span style=\"color: lightgreen;\">The rule's configuration disallows this pseudo-element in selectors.</span><br />  <br />  <strong><span style=\"color: lightgreen;\">ℹ</span></strong> <span style=\"color: lightgreen;\">Rewrite the selector without it, for example by giving the element a class and selecting it directly.</span><br />  <br />  <strong><span style=\"color: lightgreen;\">ℹ</span></strong> <span style=\"color: lightgreen;\">This rule belongs to the nursery group, which means it is not yet stable and may change in the future. Visit </span><span style=\"color: lightgreen;\"><a href=\"https://biomejs.dev/linter/#nursery\">https://biomejs.dev/linter/#nursery</a></span><span style=\"color: lightgreen;\"> for more information.</span><br />  <br /></code></pre>"} />

#### Valid

```css
input::placeholder {}
```

### `disallowAttributes`

Default: `[]`

Attribute names that aren't allowed in attribute selectors. Names must match exactly,
including letter case.

```json title='biome.json'
{
	"linter": {
		"rules": {
			"nursery": {
				"noExcessiveSelectorComplexity": {
					"level": "on",
					"options": {
						"disallowAttributes": [
							"class"
						]
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

```

#### Invalid

```css
[class*="button"] {}
```

<Fragment set:html={"<pre class=\"language-text\"><code class=\"language-text\">code-block.css:1:2 <a href=\"https://biomejs.dev/linter/rules/no-excessive-selector-complexity\">lint/nursery/noExcessiveSelectorComplexity</a> ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━<br /><br />  <strong><span style=\"color: Orange;\">⚠</span></strong> <span style=\"color: Orange;\">The attribute </span><span style=\"color: Orange;\"><strong>class</strong></span><span style=\"color: Orange;\"> isn't allowed.</span><br />  <br />  <strong><span style=\"color: Tomato;\">&gt;</span></strong> <strong>1 │ </strong>[class&#42;=&quot;button&quot;] &#123;&#125;<br />   <strong>   │ </strong> <strong><span style=\"color: Tomato;\">^</span></strong><strong><span style=\"color: Tomato;\">^</span></strong><strong><span style=\"color: Tomato;\">^</span></strong><strong><span style=\"color: Tomato;\">^</span></strong><strong><span style=\"color: Tomato;\">^</span></strong><br />    <strong>2 │ </strong><br />  <br />  <strong><span style=\"color: lightgreen;\">ℹ</span></strong> <span style=\"color: lightgreen;\">The rule's configuration disallows this attribute in selectors.</span><br />  <br />  <strong><span style=\"color: lightgreen;\">ℹ</span></strong> <span style=\"color: lightgreen;\">Rewrite the selector without it, for example by giving the element a class and selecting it directly.</span><br />  <br />  <strong><span style=\"color: lightgreen;\">ℹ</span></strong> <span style=\"color: lightgreen;\">This rule belongs to the nursery group, which means it is not yet stable and may change in the future. Visit </span><span style=\"color: lightgreen;\"><a href=\"https://biomejs.dev/linter/#nursery\">https://biomejs.dev/linter/#nursery</a></span><span style=\"color: lightgreen;\"> for more information.</span><br />  <br /></code></pre>"} />

#### Valid

```css
input[type="text"] {}
```

### `disallowAttributeMatchers`

Default: `[]`

Operators that aren't allowed in attribute selectors. Accepted values are `"="`, `"~="`,
`"|="`, `"^="`, `"$="`, and `"*="`.

```json title='biome.json'
{
	"linter": {
		"rules": {
			"nursery": {
				"noExcessiveSelectorComplexity": {
					"level": "on",
					"options": {
						"disallowAttributeMatchers": [
							"*="
						]
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

```

#### Invalid

```css
[class*="button"] {}
```

Visit </span><span style=\"color: lightgreen;\"><a href=\"https://biomejs.dev/linter/#nursery\">https://biomejs.dev/linter/#nursery</a></span><span style=\"color: lightgreen;\"> for more information.</span><br />  <br /></code></pre>"} />

#### Valid

```css
[class="button"] {}
```
